correctness.rationale: A Heawood six-cycle is uniquely the three point-pair joins of a noncollinear Fano triple, giving 35−7=28. Connectivity gives binary cycle rank 21−14+1=8; chord restriction is an isomorphism on that space since a tree has no nonzero Eulerian edge set. An independent reconstruction and integer character calculation verified span eight, the six reduced multiplicities and all six projection-kernel histogram rows. Every reduced character has 8192 extensions, so it gives the stated full histogram, rank 1212416 and nullity 884736. The maximal and least nonzero absolute multipliers are 28 and 4, giving the Hilbert-space claims. Orthogonality over characters trivial on the cycle space cancels the full inverse transform outside that subspace and leaves the 1/256 normalization inside. The absolute kernel sum is 1936/256=121/16; a point mass and the signs of the reversed kernel give the two induced endpoint norms. Averaged translation conjugates of any projection still have image in the range and fix it pointwise. The average has no larger norm and is diagonal in the character basis, with entries forced by that range. This establishes the minimum over all projections, not only convolution operators. It applies over real or complex scalars because the characters and the kernel are real.
